description: Defines an abstract class HTMLPurifier_ChildDef that manages allowed child nodes and validation logic within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes property definitions and method signatures related to child node validation and allowed elements.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ChildDef
classes.description: An abstract class providing interfaces for defining allowed child nodes and validating them within the HTMLPurifier filtering process.

methods.name: getAllowedElements
methods.description: Returns the array of elements that are permitted, based on the internal $elements property.

methods.name: validateChildren
methods.description: Abstract method to validate child nodes against definition; to be implemented by subclasses.
